title: Launch Flight Deck — Personal Scratch and Handovers
content:
Notes (rough) — flight deck style

Purpose: quick personal runbook + handoff checklist for the small-lane launch we want to run for model v2.4. Keep this lightweight; handover doc will be split out after dry-run.

High level vector:
- Quiet launch window (US-PST weekday morning) with a narrow cohort of 1% of traffic for first 30m -> 5% for next 2h -> 20% if no flags.
- Primary objective: validate latency tail under real client mix + verify safety filters at scale. Secondary: cost smoke check.

Cohorts & selection:
- Cohort A (1%): internal opt-in clients + staging tenants flagged with tag "mini-flight" (see tenant list in INF-4042).
- Cohort B (5%): gentle ramp including selected PLG sign-ups (random seeded allocation)
- Cohort C (20%): broad surfacing to non-critical production routes only (no billing-critical routes)

Routing details (engineering checklist):
- Deploy config: route map -> add entry for model=v2.4 under 'flightdeck' policy with weight 0.01.
- SDK toggle: client-side header X-RW-Experiment: flightdeck-v2.4; instruction in PR notes.
- Pin behavior: do NOT change tenant-global pins; use per-route override with TTL 1h.

Warmup and priming:
- Preflight: send 500 synthetic requests over 10 minutes matching median seq-length 128 to warm KV cache. Use script ops-scripts/warmup/flightdeck.sh.
- Seed cache for top 10 tenants in Cohort A with representative prompts.

Observability (primary dashboards):
- Dash: /dash/latency/by-route, /dash/error-rates/flightdeck, /dash/cost/per-token
- Traces: sampling at 100% for 1% cohort, 10% afterwards. Hook up trace-id -> PR number mapping.

SLO/abort signals (quick rules):
- Immediate abort if 5xx rate > 0.5% absolute increase sustained for 5m OR if p99 latency increases > 400ms (baseline) for two consecutive 5m windows.
- Slow down ramp if error delta between cohorts > 0.2% or if user complaints tagged in #prod-ops exceed 3 within first hour.

Rollback steps (fast):
- Switch route weight back to previous model variant (flightdeck -> v2.3) and set weight to 100% for 2m, then remove v2.4 from route map.
- Notify oncall and open JIRA INF-ROLLBACK-<timestamp> (templated in INF-4042).

Communication & handoff:
- Slack: post status updates in #launch-flightdeck every 10m during first hour, then 30m. Starter message template in linked GH pr.
- CS/Customer success: one-paragraph blurb for CS inbox if cohort includes customer-managed tenants.

Post-launch: data collection plan:
- Save first 24h of requests for regression evals (eval set: latency, hallucination-biased prompts, safety-filter hits).
- Run automated diffs on output quality against v2.3 using eval harness (repo evals/flightdeck).

Open questions / TODOLIST (personal):
- Confirm list of tenants to opt-in for Cohort A (ask Owen).
- Verify KMS rotation will not affect v2.4 (Lena to confirm).
- Add cost snapshot job for first 6h (cheap metric) and alert if per-token cost > 1.3x baseline.
- Decide on trace retention for flight (default 7d ok?).

Quick commands for ops (notes to self):
- route update: curl -X POST $ADMIN/routes -d '{"route":"/generate","policy":"flightdeck","weights":{"v2.4":0.01}}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN"
- warmup: bash ops-scripts/warmup/flightdeck.sh --tenants tenants-list.txt --rate 50

After-action: capture short bullet summary and attach to Confluence RL-1723. If stable after 24h, schedule slow-backfill to remaining routes and remove per-route TTLs.

Random scratch: If p99 latency is sensitive to sequence length, add fallback policy to downgrade to quantized v2.4-q when seq_len > 512. TODO: feasibility check with infra.

End of scratch. Will turn into cleaned handoff doc once we validate the dry-run.
